build.boundary: Generated embedded headers, nominal profile and selected native/core static libraries. Selected CMake values are checked; this is not a hermetic compiler/dependency or rebuild attestation.

qualification: Actual native screenshots with SDL dummy audio/video and software renderer; no physical device, deadline, accessibility, measured instrument or literal 1:1 reference qualification.

source.boundary: Observed production overlay, including untracked files; HEAD alone does not identify this UI. The author report pins its listed sources only. Extra production hashes are observed capture inputs, not an independent build attestation. Test, install-rule and unrelated documentation edits are excluded.

checked_author_report.meaning: Supplied author build report matched the current files and executable. This utility did not rebuild or independently attest source-to-binary provenance.

visual_review: Not performed by this utility. Review retained PNGs separately against the source concept.
